info.title: Geello experimental HTTP API
info.description: Implemented administration, maps/tiles, OGC Features with fixed snapshots, WMS multi-map PNG/JPEG, WMTS KVP, WFS GeoJSON KVP/XML queries and bounded WebSocket lifecycle. Typed queries are case-sensitive; legacy KVP names are case-insensitive. Unknown/duplicate fields are rejected. X-Request-Id correlates responses. Conditional writes and HEAD are supported. Errors use RFC9457 problem+json or protocol-specific legacy XML. Proxy supplies TLS/admin protection. Conformance classes remain empty; no official OGC or full WFS certification is claimed. Profile limits are experimental; platform/performance acceptance belongs to M5.

One Query supports FES 2.0 PropertyIsEqualTo/And, ResourceId OR or GML 3.2 CRS84 BBOX. Declared queryable aliases are typed. RESULTTYPE=hits returns exact numberMatched and no features. WFS bbox excludes null/empty geometry. XML rejects DTDs, external entities, unknown namespaces, excess depth/nodes and unsupported expressions. XSD uses reversible UTF-8 hex property names and honest version-wide types; it does not validate GeoJSON. No GML output or full WFS certification. Protocol errors use OWS XML; outer admission errors use problem+json.

get.summary: Upgrade to the tested WebSocket map subset
get.description: One-map WebSocket protocol 1. No URL query. Hello precedes init; init/update/retry use ASCII request IDs up to 128 bytes and atomic complete view/variant/playback/output groups. Variant is {id:'default'}. Output supports png or jpeg (explicit jpeg_quality 1-100), default 30 fps and profile ceiling. Accepted controls receive ack in receive order; superseded unstarted frames are discarded, so each ack does not promise a frame. One pending render and one serial writer bound backpressure; a started frame metadata/image pair completes before any later control/event. Metadata carries frame_id, control revision, resource render_revision, time, content_type and bytes. Playing uses a monotonic speed-scaled clock; paused updates redraw. Refresh emits resource-changed and redraws paused state; unpublish finishes any started pair then emits resource-unpublished and closes. Render failure suspends automatic frames until valid update/retry succeeds. Animation work bypasses HTTP caches. Init and each send have operation deadlines; timeout closes. Reconnect is client-owned with complete init against current resources. Independent profile.max_websocket_sessions admission applies for the entire connection; full capacity returns 503. Session buffers retain memory reservations, growing by outgoing image high-water mark. Inbound control frames/messages are limited to 64 KiB; outgoing images use max_image_bytes. Ping runs every websocket_idle_timeout_ms / 3; only received messages/Pong reset the idle timer, and idle expiry sends Close. Missing profile fields default to 64 sessions and 120000 ms idle (minimum 100 ms).
